description: Use action=native_commerce for the native commerce projection (read-only; no subscription changes or invoices). Use this when the user asks about billing state, credit balance, promo limits, subscription status, campaign-fund deposits, or whether billing blocks launches for one artist. This is a read-only status check; it does not create checkout links or collect payment. paymentMethod contains only the shared masked display details (brand or bank, type, last four digits and expiry); null means details are unavailable, not proof that no method exists. Use prefundPayments.detail for each deposit: pending = Deposit pending; action_required = Payment action required; failed = Deposit failed; confirmed = Deposit confirmed; adjusted = Funding adjustment recorded; refunded = Deposit refunded; partly_refunded = Deposit partly refunded; returned = Payment returned; disputed = Payment disputed; unavailable = Deposit status unavailable. refundAmountMinor is the proved cash refund in that deposit currency's minor units; use currencyExponent when formatting it. Never infer a cash refund from an internal adjustment or the legacy state alias. accountFundingHold is separate: 'Campaign funds are on hold. Contact support@dynamoi.com for help.' Deposit confirmation does not establish spendability or release a hold. A Checkout link alone is never a deposit. To add campaign funds, call dynamoi_add_campaign_funds if this connection has that tool; if not, use the Dynamoi dashboard at https://dynamoi.com/dashboard/marketing/billing. For other billing setup tell the user: 'You can do this in the Dynamoi dashboard at https://dynamoi.com/dashboard/marketing/billing.' Then call this tool again to confirm the status. Do not use this for campaign analytics or platform connection troubleshooting.
name: dynamoi_get_billing
